analysis.purpose: Runs a declared gate profile against a candidate memory and produces a sanitized receipt — the evidence that a claim earned its trust.
responsibilities: Execute the gate profile named by the committed policy
Produce a sanitized receipt of the outcome
Pass only fixed arguments declared in the policy

businessRules.rule: Runners take fixed arguments from the committed policy rather than free-form commands.
businessRules.rationale: A free-form command would let a candidate choose the test that blesses it.

businessRules.rule: The receipt is sanitized before it is stored.
businessRules.rationale: Raw command output can carry secrets and does not belong in committed memory.

nodes.name: Trust gate execution
nodes.summary: Evidence that a claim earned trust.
